newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Chevron says Nigerians picket stations.
newsitem.headline: Chevron says Nigerians picket stations.

text.p: Chevron Nigeria, a subsidiary of Chevron Corp, said on Tuesday that two of its oil installations in the oil-rich Nigeria delta were briefly picketed by villagers from two communities feuding with a local government over relocation of their headquarters.

"We had to shut down operations in the Utomana and Abiteye stations between 1500 GMT on Saturday and 1000 GMT on Sunday. All has however been normal since then in both stations with a combined production output of 8,000 barrels per day of crude," a company spokesman said.
